name: Inx Pro
summary: A focused open-source e-reader experience for reTerminal Sticky.
description: Inx Pro is community firmware for reTerminal Sticky with EPUB, TXT, XTC, library, image rendering, reader settings, reading statistics, Wi-Fi, OPDS, Calibre, and KOReader sync support.

compatibility.notes: For Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky with ESP32-S3 and 32MB flash. This registry entry provides a complete merged factory image.

assets.previewAlt: Inx Pro running on reTerminal Sticky

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: This package is a complete merged Sticky image. Use the erase option when replacing another firmware.

notes.title: Storage
notes.description: Insert a compatible microSD card for books, dictionaries, fonts, settings, and generated data.
